title: Colossians 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: The apostle Paul salutes the Colossians, and blesses God for their faith, love, and hope.
Prays for their fruitfulness in spiritual knowledge.
Gives a glorious view of Christ.
And sets out his own character, as the apostle of the Gentiles.

outline.text: The apostle Paul salutes the Colossians, and blesses God for their faith, love, and hope.
Prays for their fruitfulness in spiritual knowledge.
Gives a glorious view of Christ.
And sets out his own character, as the apostle of the Gentiles.

context: This epistle was sent because of some difficulties which arose among the Colossians, probably from false teachers, in consequence of which they sent to the apostle.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.

title: Colossians 2: chapter overview
paragraphs: The apostle expresses his love to, and joy in believers.
He cautions against the errors of heathen philosophy; also against Jewish traditions, and rites which had been fulfilled in Christ.
Against worshipping angels; and against legal ordinances.

title: Colossians 3: chapter overview
paragraphs: The Colossians exhorted to be heavenly-minded;
to live in mutual love, forbearance, and forgiveness;
and to practise the duties of wives and husbands, children, parents, and servants.

title: Colossians 4: chapter overview
paragraphs: Masters to do their duty towards servants.
Persons of all ranks to persevere in prayer, and Christian prudence.
The apostle refers to others for an account of his affairs.
Sends greetings; and concludes with a blessing.
